# Frozen preprocess schema 2.0 fixture

This fixture was generated by the unmodified producer code from
`origin/feature/preprocess-video` commit
`75b5204fa313c84c613141b89a0ba4462db599a1`.

Source video:

```text
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc=size=160x120:rate=10:duration=2 -pix_fmt yuv420p synthetic.mp4
```

Producer arguments:

```text
synthetic.mp4
--video-id coverage_fixture
--output-root data
--segment-method time
--segment-length-sec 1.5
--segment-overlap-sec 0
--target-fps 2
--blur-threshold 0
--keyframe-policy coverage_v1
--selection-target-gap-sec 0.5
--selection-max-gap-sec 1.0
--force
```

Only the consumer handoff files are frozen here: `frames_manifest.json`,
`keyframe_quality_report.json`, and the selected JPEG files referenced by the
manifest. Source and segmented videos are intentionally omitted.

The producer was executed from a Git archive, so the generated manifest reports
`run.code.commit == "unknown"`. The exact source commit used for generation is
recorded above.
